serve./uv/uv.config.js: generated by the adapter from uvConfig below

transport.name: epoxy
transport.summary: bare-mux 2.1.8 SharedWorker running epoxy-transport 2.1.28 (npm), over the shared holyWisp

notes: set up as Ultraviolet-App a1762248: its uv.config.js (prefix /uv/service/, xor codec, files under /uv/), the package's stock sw.js at /uv/sw.js (scope /uv/), bare-mux worker at /baremux/worker.js, epoxy at /epoxy/index.mjs
the stock uv.config.js in the package says prefix /service/ with the files at /; the app moves everything under /uv/ so the service worker scope covers the prefix; the same code either way
service worker does all fetching and rewriting (HTML/JS/CSS) itself; requests go out through bare-mux to the SharedWorker that runs the transport
transport: epoxy-transport 2.1.28 (the app's exact pin; epoxy-tls 2.1.18-1): the 16 KiB HTTP/2 header list limit STomp's patched build lifts, no HTTP/3, no ECH DoH
transport initializes lazily in the SharedWorker on the first proxied request (as in the app), so the epoxy wasm compile is inside the first load after boot
cross-origin isolation headers on every host response (COOP same-origin, COEP require-corp), as the app's server sends; UV adds COEP require-corp to proxied documents
no HTTP cache of its own beyond what the browser does for the host files (service worker fetches through bare-mux bypass the HTTP cache)
